description: A production designer must approve the final stage plan for a televised dance special, including the platform configuration, camera clearance, floor anchoring, choreography format, and production follow-up actions.

shared_context.S1: The televised dance special will be filmed in the Atrium Theater on Friday.
shared_context.S2: The current draft calls for a rotating platform, an overhead lift, floor anchors drilled into the stage, and a two-meter camera lane.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the binding approval decision for the final stage plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal production sign-off, Mara reviews the draft with technical, location, and movement staff before approving the plan.
shared_context.S5: The production's prebuild review requires the final platform, anchoring, camera-lane, and movement selections to be checked together as one compatible stage plan before sign-off.

PF1.text: Jonah confirmed during a camera-rail test that the rotating platform would enter the rail's required three-meter exclusion lane; the technically approved layout is a fixed platform with a three-meter camera lane. He recorded the test in the technical log but has not yet updated Mara's design draft.

PF2.text: Elise confirmed with the theater's preservation officer that drilling into the Atrium Theater floor is prohibited, and the approved replacement requires exactly 18 ballast bases for a freestanding platform. She received the written restriction this morning but it has not been added to the location packet.

PF3.text: Rafael reviewed the lead dancer's current medical clearance with the performer and choreographer; it prohibits overhead lifts for this shoot, while the cleared replacement is a floor duet. Rafael has the signed clearance note but has not entered the movement change in the rehearsal report.

acceptance_conditions: The final platform must be fixed and freestanding.
The camera lane must be exactly three meters.
The platform must use exactly 18 ballast bases instead of drilled floor anchors.
The movement format must be a floor duet rather than an overhead lift.
A document update for Elise's floor-protection finding must be logged.

content_checks.C3: decisions['anchor_method'] == '18 ballast bases for freestanding platform' or decisions['anchor_method'] == '18 ballast bases for a freestanding platform'
content_checks.C5: '18' in decisions['anchor_method'] and 'ballast' in decisions['anchor_method'] and any('drilling' in c['detail'] and ('prohibition' in c['detail'] or 'restriction' in c['detail']) and 'ballast' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The camera-rail test changes the platform from rotating to fixed and the lane from two meters to exactly three meters.
The theater restriction changes the anchor method from drilled floor anchors to exactly 18 ballast bases and requires the restriction and replacement method to be logged and cited.
The signed medical clearance changes the movement format from an overhead lift to a floor duet.
